en: Sepia-toned photograph of a military parade in a snowy or frosty street lined with low wooden and masonry buildings in a Nordic / Baltic-looking town. Soldiers in dark uniforms and tall boots march in formation, some bearing armbands and a light-colored flag with an emblem. More uniformed men and civilians stand at attention along the side. The architecture features wooden façades with pilasters and multi-pane windows. There is handwritten text along the left margin of the card and a small sign on a building in a language using the Latin alphabet.
